alibabacloud-polardb-mysql-inspection v0.0.1 – Initial Release

- Provides health inspection for Alibaba Cloud PolarDB MySQL instances with visual HTML report output.
- Supports five inspection dimensions: resource monitoring, space analysis, slow query log analysis, session diagnostics, and alert history.
- Allows inspection in single-instance, multi-instance, and full-account (all instances) modes.
- Strictly uses the encapsulated python3 scripts/health-inspect.py for all data collection; direct database connection and manual aliyun data queries are not permitted.
- Includes predefined keyword mappings and usage examples for different inspection scenarios.
